_: Kairo, for Gloss reels. The single source of truth for anything a reel says or shows. Read it; never quote from memory.

business.name: Kairo
business.what: Booking, clients and payments for a salon

price.source: Kairo platform: KAIRO_PRICE_CENTS = 41000 (platform/render.yaml, platform/signup.js), the amount the live checkout charges. Checked 12 Oct 2026.
price.forever: '$0 a month, forever' is the website's own wording (kairobookings.com). Never 'special offer' (it is the normal price) or 'yours to keep forever' (the terms don't promise it).

cta.presenter: A presenter who is not the seller never says "DM me": she says "DM the word Kairo". The DM still goes to the seller's account.
cta.why: The website is not launched for this audience; the reel sells a conversation.

notifyPrompt.claim: It asks before it texts your client.
notifyPrompt.true: Every booking the owner makes or moves, and every cancellation, asks once at the moment of saving: Email them, Text them, Email and text them, or Don't send anything (You'll tell them yourself). Only the channels that client can actually receive are offered.

facts.textsCost: Texts go through the salon's own ClickSend account, a few cents each; Kairo adds nothing.
facts.doubleBooking: The diary refuses an overlapping booking for the same person unless the owner forces it.

competitors.rule: Never named in a reel. Compare against 'your booking app' and an example bill ($99 a month), labelled as an example in the fine print.

voice.design: Australian woman, early 30s. Warm and quick, slightly dry, a bit of edge. Runs her own business and is telling another owner something genuinely useful: not a narrator, not an ad read. Conversational pace with real variation in it. Light natural texture, not polished.
voice.write: To be said, not read. Short sentences. Contractions everywhere except "cannot".
